arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' ORDER BY name

SELECT 'config' AS kind, service AS id, value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',o.event_id,json_object('booking_id',o.booking_id,'payload',json(o.payload),'status',o.status,'attempts',o.attempts,'booking_status',b.status,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents) FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=o.booking_id WHERE o.status!='delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_booking',booking_id,json_object('request_id',request_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'passenger_id',passenger_id,'amount_cents',amount_cents,'status',status) FROM bookings WHERE status!='confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancellation',event_id,json_object('request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events

SELECT 'booking_audit' AS kind,b.booking_id AS id,json_object('status',b.status,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id),'charges',(SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'captured',(SELECT count(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents),'checkins',(SELECT count(*) FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.flight_id=b.flight_id AND c.passenger_id=b.passenger_id),'delivered',(SELECT count(*) FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered')) AS data FROM bookings b UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',event_id,json_object('status',status,'payload',json(payload),'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status!='delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'capacity',f.flight_id,json_object('capacity',f.capacity,'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)) FROM flights f UNION ALL SELECT 'config',service,value FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',event_id,json_object('request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events
